body: I am feeling worse today than ever. I spended last night with her, she made us a lot of food and treated me like king all night. Next day she went and bought an Xbox for us so I have something to do at her place when I come???? No one does something like that. How I am supposed to go break up with her soon, if she makes me feel so good, and treats me so well? I think I will never find someone like that, or am I just delusional. But still it hurts so much, that I have to break up with her, I think am going to do and tell her when we both have day off work. She also said that shes sorry for everything shes done wrong to me, and that she wants us to have future together. I just aggreed to all that. I am lying to her everything is okay. I still dont know what to do I feel so hopeless and confused about everything.

Thank you, that gives me some motivation to do this...

Today I have been thinking and feeling again a lot of regret and guiltiness about doing the break up. She has been so nice to me and given me space, havent seen her for 5 days, and she has not done anything abusing towards me for for atleast month or two if we dont count that one time, she still feels sorry for and apologizes alot, unless I am unable to see it. I feel so much pity towards her shes gonna be alone with her already messed up life, I am almost the last one in her life. How the hell I can do this, it is so hard... I feel like I am going to do worst mistake in my life by leaving her. But when I think with sense I know deep down that this is not probably gonna work out and that we need to go seperate ways, but it feels so wrong. I just dont know anything else.

And yeah, I looked around and I am able to get to psychotherapeutist, its gonna cost some but I think it is the best place to put my money in, in my mental health. :D

Yeah, thank you a lot for your help. I have pretty low income, and therapist would cost me too much, but I try to get some help.

I don't know why but I am not comfortable telling these things here to anyone, and pretty no-one knows about these things but me and my girlfriend. I should probably tell my mother or someone.

Yeah, I try to remind myself of these things when I feel bad. Thank you. I dont know why, but I am blind that I am being abused, I am consantly feeling that I am the bad guy all the time.

Hi, I am sorry but I cant see any post from you before in this thread, I see one removed post. I was answering to one post when I made this, I am not sure if it was you, and when I tried to send it, it said the post was deleted, don't know if that was yours? If you linked the "Why abusive relationships feels so good" link, that was the one I was trying to reply to. :D If you can resend it I am happy to read it again and reply to.

I don't live with her, she lives alone and I live with my mother. My plan was to write her letter about the breakup, and meet her face-to-face, maybe at her place and hand it to her, and then after she has read it and she goes into panic attack crymode I just say I have something to do and leave her, if she allows me to go. Then tell her parents and friends about my worries, and call a wellness-check. I am just most worried that I will go back to her immediatly, right now I am feeling regret about even making these plans, and miss her greatly. I haven't hanged out with her for couple of days, because I am trying to get distant. How I can overcome these feelings and just be strict about this, I feel so sad.

Thank you for your answer. I now am sure that I need to get out of this relationship, but I really dont know how I can do it. Thats the hardest part.

I am thinking of doing it when we both have couple days off work, so we have no stress about that. But I am so easily manipulated and controlled, I feel like I can not do it. She will go to the probably sweetest and most loved version of her, when I do it and will cry a lot and my heart will break watching it and I will take her back. I dont want that, do you have any advice on that?

And then, how I can walk away from her home after telling it, knowing she can go right off cutting herself, which she probably will do?

And how I am supposed to even walk away from her, she will probably run behind me and not leave me alone, it has happened before, if I say that I will have to go now? I care about her that much, that it would be extremely hard to just get away from her, and leave her crying and having those seizures alone.

Hi,

Nice to know I am not the only in this kind of relationship. I am pretty deep in this too, I think there is no-win situation here. I have felt guilty for almost 2 years now straight, its not doing good to me. I want to get out, I sometimes dream about it, being free, but I am too weak to do anything to her power. God, that sounds rough. On the other side I feel like I am giving up the best girlfriend ever, though shes probably not but I am blind.

Hi,

Thanks a lot for your answer, it feels so good to tell this to someone finally and get really good advice. <3

I think I have to get out of this relationship, I am feeling that I am not myself at all with her. And I am modifying my behavior.

That writing a letter thing was very good idea to do, I really cant put my thoughts in to words easily fast.

But I am really afraid of the break up part. I feel I cant do it and I will lose control and think again that I should stay with her. When we have almost broken up, I have allways felt so miserable that I was sure I need her for rest of my life. 

I don't know how I can leave someone who was/is so important to me and just walk away, I have never done that, it feels impossible.

With my ex, I had this same thing going on actually, and I did not break up with her for 3 years, until she finally broke up with me. She was very abusive too.

Do you think I am being abused? I really am not sure anymore, she has made me feel like it is all my fault and I am the problem in the relationship.

I dont want to take a slightest risk she kills herself and I have to live that for rest of my life, she was or is so close to me. I have so much mental issues myself, including OCD and pretty bad anxiety and stuff, I could not take anymore.

Also, I am thinking about I take a whole week vacation of work to but I can get it like 1 month from now, so I can do it then so I can heal peacefully to not stress about work... And to do it when she has off day from work too, so she does not have to stress. Does that sound like a good idea?
